author: StewieFG
body:
Hello :)

Sidenote: this post is written from an iPad with the autocorrect, so expect a really bad grammar and bad English :/
I think it would be really useful if we had a kind of a tab near the my discussion categories to my replies, so if someone replied to you in a post it will show up who replied to you, what date and the original post name and if you click on it it will link you to your post that someone have replied too. I think it would be useful in big threads when people reply to your posts a lot.
Opinions?
